selection: minimum full-card validation race log loss, separately SEOUL/BUSAN, Brier as secondary evidence; no test-dependent tuning
calibration: fit auxiliary pooled model through 2021, per-venue temperature from 2022 only, apply to pooled model trained through 2022; no validation/test labels used for calibration
expanding_calibration: auxiliary pooled model through evaluation_year-2; temperatures on evaluation_year-1; main models through evaluation_year-1
dead_heat: divide unit target mass equally among official first-place horses; top1/top3 any official winner; race Brier sum of squared errors to fractional target
notes: Full historical declared-card completeness cannot be proven from results-derived entries. Full-card here denotes all supplied entries.
DQ and DNF retained with zero mass. Cancellation publication time unknown; final-starter evaluation is conditional and retrospective.
No odds, no ROI, no production promotion.
